name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B EXL3 3.5bpw HQ
description: EXL3 (exllamav3) HQ quantization of NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B (88-layer hybrid mamba-attention-MoE with MTP; text arch remapped from the omni checkpoint). Encoded -b 3.5 --hq (3.5bpw experts, 5bpw attention+dense, 16bpw head and embeddings). The pack holds the language model only, no vision tower: text only.

verified.notes: text only; one run per kind, 512 greedy, thinking off, LiLiCorr + lookup from the 4.0 profile; 53.58 GiB at load; top-1 99.6 % against the converter's own forward on 512 positions
